name: Contrast (Enhanced)
explanation: This is the stricter, AAA-level version of the contrast requirement in SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum). Instead of the AA minimums of 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text, this criterion requires a contrast ratio of at least 7:1 for normal-size text and at least 4.5:1 for large text (18pt/24px and up, or 14pt/18.66px and up if bold). A color pairing can easily satisfy AA's 4.5:1 minimum while still falling well short of this enhanced 7:1 threshold — passing one does not mean passing the other. As with 1.4.3, this applies to real text and images of text, and does not apply to logos, incidental text in photos, or purely decorative text. Because it demands noticeably higher contrast than most default design-system palettes provide, SC 1.4.6 is one of the harder AAA criteria to meet without deliberately choosing darker or more saturated text colors.
whoItAffects: People with low vision, including many who do not meet the legal definition of blindness but still need much higher contrast than typical AA-compliant designs provide, benefit directly from the enhanced ratio. This includes people with reduced contrast sensitivity from conditions like cataracts, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, or age-related macular degeneration, for whom a 4.5:1 pairing that looks fine to someone with typical vision may still be difficult or impossible to read without magnification. It also helps people reading on devices with poor screen quality, reflective or matte coatings that wash out contrast, or in challenging lighting such as strong glare, as well as anyone experiencing temporary visual fatigue or eye strain during long reading sessions.
howToTest: Use a contrast checker (such as the free WebAIM Contrast Checker, or the eyedropper/contrast tools built into most browsers' DevTools) to sample the actual foreground text color and the actual background color behind it, then read the calculated ratio. First check the text's size and weight: text at 18pt/24px or larger (or 14pt/18.66px or larger and bold) only needs 4.5:1 under this criterion; all smaller text needs 7:1. Many color pairs that already pass SC 1.4.3's AA thresholds will still fail here, so re-check every distinct text/background combination on the page -- body copy, links, form labels, placeholder text, and text over images -- against the higher bar rather than assuming an AA pass is good enough.

check.question: Body text at 16px, normal weight, has a measured contrast ratio of 4.54:1 against its background. Does this pass SC 1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced)?
choices: Yes, because 4.54:1 exceeds the 4.5:1 minimum required for normal text
No, because normal-size text requires at least 7:1 under this AAA criterion, and 4.54:1 falls well short
Yes, because SC 1.4.6 only applies to large text, not normal-size text
It depends on whether the page also satisfies SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)
